name: Seurat niches
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which niches the tissue divides into, judged by the cell types around each cell.
long_description: Groups cells into niches by the cell types among their nearest neighbours, with BuildNicheAssay from the authors' Seurat package. Paints the niches on the map, with their composition and a download of every cell's niche.
citation: Hao Y, Stuart T, Kowalski MH, et al. Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis. Nat Biotechnol 42, 293-304 (2024).

params.name: field
params.label: Cell-type column (group.by)
params.help:
Selects the annotation whose groups are counted around each cell.
Defaults to the dataset's cell-type column.

params.name: niches_k
params.label: Number of niches (niches.k)
params.help:
Sets how many niches k-means makes.
The authors use 5 in their Xenium vignette.

params.name: neighbors_k
params.label: Spatial neighbours (neighbors.k)
params.help:
Sets how many nearest cells form each cell's neighbourhood.
More neighbours give broader niches; the authors use 30.

params.name: iter_max
params.label: K-means iterations (iter.max)
params.help:
Sets the maximum number of iterations in each of k-means' 30 starts.
Raise it when the summary says that starts stopped at this limit.
